# PYMNTS

> > PYMNTS provides news, analysis, and intelligence on payments, commerce, artificial intelligence, B2B innovation, and the digital transformation of global business and finance.

PYMNTS covers the intersection of technology and commerce, with deep focus on AI adoption (OpenAI, Anthropic, agentic AI), cryptocurrency and payment rails, supply chain digitization, retail innovation, and regulatory developments affecting digital payments and trade. The site features original research through PYMNTS Intelligence and tracks how enterprises like FedEx, Deutsche Bank, Target, and Amazon are navigating technological and economic disruption.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI and Enterprise AI
- Payment Rails and Digital Banking
- Stablecoins and Cryptocurrency
- Supply Chain Digitization
- B2B Payments and Cross-Border Transactions
- AI Security and Testing
- Federal Reserve and Financial Regulation
- Trade Policy and Tariffs
- Retail Innovation and E-commerce
- Small Business Finance
- Cybersecurity and Data Privacy
- Treasury Management
- OpenAI and AI Model Development
- Blockchain Infrastructure
- Consumer Confidence and Economic Indicators
